prop.name: text
prop.help: Set text displayed instead of the selected option label

prop.name: options
prop.help: Set options as a newline (`\n`) separated string

prop.name: symbol
prop.help: Set a symbol shown next to the dropdown

prop.name: bind_value
prop.help: Bind the selected option index to a subject

prop.name: dir
prop.help: Tells in which direction the dropdown should be opened

element.name: list
element.help: The dropdown list object for styling or customization

part.name: main
part.help: The open list background: background, border and padding. `max_height` caps the open list size.

part.name: scrollbar
part.help: The list's scrollbar: `width` (thickness), background properties and padding on the respective side.

part.name: selected
part.help: The highlighted option: background and text properties. The 'checked' state styles the currently selected option and 'pressed' the one being pressed/keyed.

part.name: main
part.help: The closed button: background and text properties. Gets the 'checked' state while the list is open.

part.name: indicator
part.help: The symbol shown next to the text (set via `symbol`): `image_recolor` and `image_recolor_opa`.
